question: How many divisions of the knower are recognized when examined in detail versus in principal classification?
premises: When examined, the state of the knower extends into countless divisions of knowers.
A principal classification is also possible.
In that principal classification, seven divisions of knowers are proclaimed.
inference: Therefore the divisions of the knower are innumerable in analysis but are taught as seven in their chief forms.
plain_english: When examined closely, this gives rise to countless divisions of knowers. But in terms of the main classification, only seven divisions of the knower are proclaimed.
